41:47: ɣuṛeS ay tella tmusni n yimir. Ur d iteffeɣ uzway si txeddact is, ur treffed nnta tadist, ur teţţarew, siwa ma Iẓṛa. Ass ideg ar asen Isiwel: "anda ten icriken iW"? A d inin: "ad aK nini, ur illi garaneɣ unagi".
41:48: Iooa ten wayen uɣuṛ ţnujun zik. Fehmen, ur asen illi ssṛan.
41:49: Ur ifeccel ara umdan di tuţţra n lxiṛ. Ma inul it lqeṛḥ, ad iayes, ad innuɣben.
41:50: Ma Nseḥess as aḥunu nneɣ, deffir ccqa i t iḥuzan, war ccekk, ad yini: "ayagi inu. Ur cukkeɣ ara imir a d ias. Ma bbwḍeɣ s afus n Mass iw, ad afeɣ ɣuṛeS ṣṣam". Ih, a Nbeggen ayen xedmen, i wid ijehlen, u, ih, ad Nsɛaddi fellasen aɛaqeb iwaɛṛen.
41:51: Ma Nɣat amdan ad iwexxeṛ, izzi akin. Ma iḥuza t lḥif, ad iţnuju, irennu.
41:52: Ini: "tmeyyzem ma iusa d sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, u kunwi tnekṛem t"? Anwa innetlafen sennig win illan di ticuṭna tuɣmiqt?
41:53: Ad asen Nessken issekniyen nneɣ di tmurt akked igenwan, u deg iman nnsen, alamma ţţutebbten ar neţţa d tideţ. Day ur Iqadd ara Mass ik mi Neţţa, war ccekk, d Anagi n yal cci?
41:54: Day, s tideţ, cukken timlilit d Mass nnsen? Day Neţţa, s tideţ, ur Izzi ara i yal cci?
42:3: Akka i Iweḥḥa i kečč, akked wid ik id izwaren, Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
42:4: IneS i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Neţţa, d Aɛlayen, d Ameqwṛahan.
42:5: Qṛib ad ccergen igenwan seg ixfawen nnsen, mara d lhint lmalayek deg usbuccaɛ s ccekṛan n Mass nnsent, u ssuturent ad ţwassemḥen kra illan di tmurt. War ccekk, Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu?
42:6: Wid irran imawlan, war Neţţa, Iquṛaɛ ten Ṛebbi. Ur telliḍ, kečč, d awkil nnsen.
42:7: Akka ay k n Nweḥḥa Leqwṛan, s taɛṛabt, iwakken a ţnedṛeḍ tayimmaţ n temdinin, akked wayen i s d izzin; a ţnedṛeḍ af ass n temlilit, ur degs ccekk; arbaɛ di Loennet, arbaɛ deg ujajiḥ.
42:8: Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, yili Izdukkel iten d yiwen n lois. Maca, ad Issekcem win i S ihwan ar uḥunu S. Imednas, ur sɛin bab neɣ asettaṛ.
42:9: Neɣ rran imawlan, war Neţţa. Ṛebbi d Neţţa ay d Bab, d Neţţa i Issidiren lmeggtin, d Neţţa i Izemren i yal cci.
42:10: Ayen akw iɣef temgarradem, aḥuddu s ar Ṛebbi. Akka Ṛebbi, Mass iw; fellaS ţţekleɣ, ɣeṛ Neţţa ay steṛoiɛeɣ.
42:11: Axellaq n tmurt akked igenwan. Seg iman nnwen Irra yawen tiyugiwin; si lmal nnwen, tiyugiwin. Isfukti kwen yisent. Ur illi wayen i T icban. Neţţa Issel, Iţwali.
42:12: IneS tisura n tmurt akked igenwan. Issugut ṛṛeẓq i win i S ihwan, Iwezzen. Ih, Neţţa Issen yal cci.
42:13: Issers awen d, di ddin, ayen iɣef Iweṣṣa Nuḥ. Ayen i k Nweḥḥa, d ayen iɣef Nweṣṣa Ibṛahim, Musa, akked Ɛisa: "sbeddet ddin, ur ţţemgarradet fellas". ẒẒẒẓay, i imcurak, wayen uɣuṛ la ten tneccdeḍ. Ṛebbi Iţţawi ɣuṛeS, win i S ihwan; Inehhu ɣuṛeS, win isteṛoiɛen.
42:14: Ur mfaṛaqen armi ten id tusa tussna. Pţemḍuddun. Lemmer ur d izwar wawal sɣuṛ Mass ik ɣef lmijal iţwassnen, yili myefran. Ih, wid iweṛten Tazmamt deffir sen, haaten, fellas, di ccekk imcebbwel.
42:15: Ilmend n waya, enced, ssewqem akken i teţwamṛeḍ, ur teddu d cchawi nnsen. Ini: "umneɣ s wayen id Issader Ṛebbi n Tira. Pwamṛeɣ d ad wezneɣ garawen. Ṛebbi d Mass nneɣ, u d Mass nnwen. I nekwni igiten nneɣ, i kunwi igiten nnwen. Ur teţţili nnmara garaneɣ. Ṛebbi ad aɣ Issemlil. Tuɣalin ɣuṛeS".
42:16: Wid iţnamaren af Ṛebbi, deffir wagwaḍ n loawab ɣuṛsen, ur teswi nnmara nnsen, ar Mass nnsen. Fellasen zzɛaf, fellasen aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
42:17: Ṛebbi id Issadren Tazmamt, s tideţ, akked lmizan. W ad ak imlen, ahat imir iqeṛb ed?
42:18: Ḥaren ɣuṛes wid ur numin ara yis. Ma d wid iumnen, ugaden t; ẓṛan ar neţţa d tideţ. Ih, wid icukken deg imir, haaten, war ccekk, di ttelfan uɣmiq.
42:19: Ṛebbi d Laṭif i imdanen iS. Iţɣiti win i S ihwan. Neţţa d Uohid, d Uzmir.
42:20: Win ibɣan tayerza n laxeṛt, ad as Nernu di tyerza ines. Win ibɣan tayerza n ddunit, ad as Nefk segs. Ur as illi umur di laxeṛt.
42:21: Neɣ sɛan icriken, sseɣṛen ten di ddin ur Iqbil Ṛebbi? Lemmer ur d izwir ara wawal n ufraz, a ţ fru garasen. I imednas, war ccekk, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
42:22: A ţwaliḍ imednas feqɛen ilmend n wayen kesben, u neţţa iddehm ed fellasen. Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, ad ilin di tebḥirin n leonanat. Nnsen i sen ihwan ɣuṛ Mass nnsen. D wagi ay d lfeḍl ameqwṛan.
42:23: D wagi is Iţbecciṛ Ṛebbi imdanen iS, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ taqdiɛt, af waya, siwa lmaḥnana i llezm nnwen". Win ixedmen iseɣ, ad as Nernu degs lehhu. Ṛebbi, ih, Iţsemmiḥ, Iţţara tajmilt.
42:24: Neɣ a d inin: "isnulfa d tikerkas af Ṛebbi". Ma ihwa yaS i Ṛebbi, ad Icemmaɛ ul ik. S wawal iS, ad Isqucc Ṛebbi tikerkas, ad Iḥeqqeq tideţ. Ih, Neţţa Iẓṛa tababnit n idmaren.
42:25: D Neţţa i Iqeblen nndama n yimdanen iS. Iţsemmiḥ tucmitin. Issen ayen txeddmem.
42:26: Issemḥas i wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan. Ad asen Irnu si lfeḍl iS. I ijehliyen, aɛaqeb uqsiḥ.
42:27: Ma Issuget Ṛebbi lɣit i imdanen iS, ad beɣwḍen di tmurt. Maca, Issrusu d, s lmizan, ayen i S ihwan. Ih, Neţţa Iţţuxebbeṛ ɣef imdanen iS, Iţwali ten.
42:28: D Neţţa id Isseɣlayen ageffur mara aysen. Iweţţaɛ aḥunu S. Neţţa d Bab, d Amaɛzuz.
42:29: Seg issekniyen iS, lxelq n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan n lewḥuc, degsen. Izmer Neţţa, ma ihwa yaS, a ten id Issemlil.
42:30: Kra n tiyta ikwen iwwten, siwa ayen d bbwin ifassen nnwen. Aṭas i Iţsemmiḥ.
42:31: Ur tezmirem a ţţesfunngem di tmurt. Ur awen illi, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ asettaṛ.
42:32: Seg issekniyen iS, ssfinat di yill, amzun d idurar.
42:33: Ma ihwa yaS ad Issens aḍu, ad ḥebsent, d tusbiḍin sufella s. War ccekk, ayagi d issekniyen i yal aṣebṛi isnemmiren.
42:34: Neɣ a ten Issenger ilmend n wayen kesben. Aṭas i Iţsemmiḥ.
42:35: Ad ẓṛen wid iţnamaren ɣef issekniyen nneɣ, ar ur asen illi ssṛan.
42:36: Ayen akw i wen iţţunefken n wayla, d zzhu n tmeddurt di ddunit. Ayen illan ar Ṛebbi, yif it; ad idum kteṛ, i wid iumnen, iţţeklen ɣef Mass nnsen;
42:37: wid ijunben ibekkaḍen ibararen, akked lɛaṛ, u ssurufen i wid i ten isserfan;
42:38: wid id iţjawaben i Mass nnsen, ţẓallan, ţţemcawaṛen ɣef lameṛ nnsen, ţseddiqen seg wayen iten Nɣat;
42:39: wid, ma iusa ten lbeɣwḍ, ad qablen.
42:40: Aqeṭṭi n tucmiţ, d tucmiţ i ţ icban. Win isemmḥen, issweqmen, arraz is ar Ṛebbi. Neţţa, ih, ur Iḥemmel ara imednas.
42:41: Ma d wid id irran ţţaṛ mi ţwadensen, ur telli tiyta degsen.
42:42: Tiyta, kan, deg wid iḍuṛṛen imdanen, iqehṛen di tmurt, war ssebba. I wigi, aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
42:43: Ma d win iṣebṛen, isemmḥen, ayagi, s tideţ, d aseyyi n lumuṛ.
42:44: Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur isɛi bab, deffir eS. A ţwaliḍ imednas, mara ẓṛen aɛaqeb, ad inin: "ma illa ubrid n tuɣalin"?
42:45: A ten twaliḍ ţwafessren fellas, ndellen, ggaren tiṭ s tugwdi. Ad inin wid iumnen: "imexsuṛen, s tideţ, d wid i sxesṛen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". War ccekk, deg uɛaqeb imezgi, ara yilin imednas.
42:46: Ur asen llin imawlan, ara ten isellken, war Ṛebbi. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur isɛi abrid.
42:47: Jawbet i Mass nnwen, uqbel a d ias, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ass ur neţwexxiṛ. Ur awen iţţili ssṛan assen, ur tezmirem a ţnekṛem.
42:48: Ma numren, ur k id Nuzen ara d amḥareb nnsen. Ay fellak, siwa timenna. Ih, mara Nesḥess i umdan aḥunu sɣuṛneɣ, ad ifṛeḥ yis. Mara t tsami tucmiţ, id bbwin ifassen is, s tideţ, amdan ad ikaraɛ.
42:49: N Ṛebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ixelleq ayen i S ihwan. Iţţak nnta i win i S ihwan, Iţţak ddkeṛ i win i S ihwan.
42:50: Neɣ Iţcarak ddkeṛ d nnta. Isaɛqaṛ win i S ihwan. Ih, Neţţa Issen, Izmer.
42:51: Ur iţţunefk ara i umdan, ad as Immeslay Ṛebbi, siwa aweḥḥi, neɣ deffir ucembir, neɣ a d iazen amazan iwumi ara Iweḥḥi, s tsriḥ iS, ayen Ibɣa. Ih, Neţţa d Aɛlayen, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
42:52: Akka ik d Nweḥḥa ṛṛuḥ, si lameṛ nneɣ; ur telliḍ d win issnen d acu ţ Tezmamt, neɣ liman. Maca, nerra ţ d tafat. Yis Nenehhu win i ɣ ihwan, seg imdanen nneɣ. Ih, d Kečč i iţţawin d ubrid uwqim;
42:53: abrid n Ṛebbi, i Isɛan i illan di tmurt, i illan deg igenwan. War ccekk, ar Ṛebbi ay teddun lumuṛ.
43:3: Nerra ţ d Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, amar a ţfehmem.
43:4: Neţţa, ih, ata ɣuṛneɣ, ar Tyimmaţ n Tezmamt, d aɛlayan, d uṣwib.
43:5: Day a kwen Nḥewwej seg usmekti, imi kunwi d agdud iţḥawalen?
43:6: Acḥal id Nuzen d nnbi i imezwura!
43:7: Ur ten id iţţas nnbi, mebla ma mmaɛlken fellas.
43:8: Nemḥa wid i ten yifen tazmert. U iṣaṛ umedya imezwura.
43:9: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten: "anwa i Ixelqen tamurt akked igenwan"? A d inin, war ccekk: "Ixelq iten Uzmir, Amusnaw";
43:10: i wen Irran tamurt d dduḥ; i wen Igan, degs, iberdan - amendeṛ ma a ţţeţţwanhum -;
43:11: id Isseɣlayen, seg igenni, aman s lmizan - Nessakway yissen tamurt immuten; akka ara d tekkrem -;
43:12: id Ixelqen akw tiyugiwin, i wen Ifkan, si sfinat akked lmal, ara trekbem.
43:13: A ţɛanncem ɣef iɛrar nnsen; sinna, a d tesmektim lɣit n Mass nnwen, mara ţɛanncem fellasen. A ţţinim: "gedha s Win i d Inuben fellaɣ s waya, ur t nemlik!
43:15: Ḥesben ay T iɛabden d amur segS. Amdan, s tideţ, d anekkaṛ n ṣṣeḥ.
43:16: Neɣ day d Iddem tullas seg wayen Ixleq, u Ifren awen d arrac?
43:17: Ma ibbweḍ ed usali yiwen segsen, ɣef wayen id ifka d amedya i Uḥnin, ad yibrik wudem is, ad ikkufer:
43:18: "ayen d ikren di rrḥuḥ, ur nessifrir anamer"!
43:19: Ḥesben lmalayek, i illan d ixdimen n Uḥnin, d nnta. Day ḥeḍṛen i uxlaq nnsent? Tira ɣef ccada nnsen; fellasen asteqsi.
43:20: Nnan: "lemmer Irad Uḥnin, yili ur ten naɛbbid". Ur sɛin kra n tmusni ɣef waya. Nitni la ţxeṛṛiḍen kan.
43:21: Neɣ Nefka yasen Tazmamt, uqbel Tagi, dɣa, degs, ṭṭfen.
43:22: Xaṭi! Nnan: "nufa d, ih, imezwura nneɣ, di laɛqida. Dɣa, nekwni, Nedda di lateṛ nnsen".
43:23: Am akka, ur d Nuzen, uqbel ik, aneddaṛ ar temdint, mebla ma nnan isɛiyen is: "nufa d imezwura nneɣ di laɛqida. Dɣa, nedda d lateṛ nnsen".
43:24: Inna: "i ma bbwiɣ awen d nnhaya yifen tin id tufam ar imezwura nnwen"? Nnan: "nekwni, ihi, nugwi ayen is id teţţuceggɛam".
43:25: Nerra d ţţaṛ, segsen. Muqel amek teḍṛa d inekkaṛen.
43:26: Mi inna Ibṛahim i baba s, akked ugdud is: "nek, ur ţkkaɣ deg wayen la tɛabdem,
43:27: kkes ed Win iyi d Ixelqen. D Neţţa, s tideţ, ara iyi Inhun".
43:28: Irra t d awal imezgi i texlift is, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
43:29: U ɣateɣ ten, nitni akked imezwura nnsen, armi ten id tusa tideţ, akked umazan iţbegginen.
43:30: Mi ten id tusa tideţ, nnan: "wagi d ssḥur, ihi, nekwni nugi t".
43:31: Nnan: "A lemmer id ssadren Leqwṛan agi ar urgaz ameqwṛaḥan n snat temdinin"!
43:32: Day d nitni i ifeṛṛqen aḥunu n Mass ik? D Nekwni i sen Ifeṛṛqen tamɛict nnsen, di tmeddurt n ddunit, u Nessuli kra segsen, tidekkaṛin sennig wiyaḍ, iwakken kra, ad sxedmen wiyaḍ. Aḥunu n Mass ik yif ayen jemɛan.
43:33: Lemmer mačči yiwen n lois kan ara yilin imdanen, a Nerr tiseddura n lfeṭṭa i ixxamen n wid inekṛen Aḥnin, akw i tiseddaṛin iɣef ara alin;
43:34: i ixxamen nnsen, tibbura; imṭeṛḥen ideg ara ẓlen;
43:35: akked uzewweq. Maca, ayagi akw, d astumen i tmeddurt n ddunit. Laxeṛt, ar Mass ik, i wid iţḥezziben.
43:36: Win iooan asmekti n Uḥnin, ad as Nqelled Cciṭan, ad as yili d amsaɛef.
43:37: Ih, Nitni ḍeṛṛifen ten seg ubrid, u ɣilen ar nitni ţwanhan.
43:38: Alamma ma iusa d ɣuṛneɣ, inna d: "ah, awufan gari yidek, amecwaṛ illan ger ugmuḍ d wayeḍ". A yir amsaɛef!
43:39: Ur kwen infaɛ, assa, d awezɣi, ma tdensem. Aql akwen tcerkem aɛaqeb.
43:40: Day a ţţerreḍ, kečč, aɛeẓẓug ad issel, neɣ a ţţenhuḍ aderɣal, akked win illan di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ?
43:41: Amar a k id Nekkes, dɣa a d Nerr ţţaṛ segsen;
43:42: neɣ ak Nessken ayen i sen d Nhegga. ɣuṛneɣ, ih, adabu fellasen.
43:43: Ṭṭef deg wayen i k d iţţuweḥḥan. Kečč, war ccekk, aql ak deg ubrid uwqim.
43:44: Wagi, ih, d asmekti i kečč, akked ugdud ik; deqqal fellawen asteqsi.
43:45: Steqsi wid id Nuzen, uqbel ik, seg imazanen nneɣ. Day Nerra, war Aḥnin, iṛebbiten ara ɛabden?
43:46: Niɣ Nuzen ed Musa s issekniyen nneɣ, ar Ferɛun akked imḍebbṛen is. Inna: "nek d amazan n Mass imaḍalen".
43:47: Mi sen d ibbwi issekniyen nneɣ, nitni la ţţaḍsan degsen.
43:48: Ur asen Nessenɛata assekni, siwa ma iɣleb gma s. Nesɛadda fellasen aɛaqeb, amar a d uɣalen s abrid.
43:49: Nnan: "a yaseḥḥar, nɛaṛ aɣ Mass ik, s lemɛahda i k Ifka. Nekwni ara neţwanhu".
43:50: Mi Nessafer aɛaqeb fellasen, imiren ad xedɛan.
43:51: Imdeḥ Ferɛun i ugdud is, inna: "a yagdud iw, day mačči inu tagelda n Maseṛ, akked isaffen agi, i iţţazalen seddaw i. Day ur twalam ara?
43:52: Neɣ nek ur ifeɣ ara imdelli agi, ur nezmir ad ibeggen?
43:53: Acimi ur as qqnen ara imeqyasen n uwṛeɣ, neɣ ur d usint ara yides lmalayek, ţwazdan t"?
43:54: Issefqaɛ agdud is. Unzen as. Wigi, ih, d agdud ucmit.
43:55: Mi ɣ zzaɛfen, Nerra d ţţaṛ segsen, Neɣmeq iten meṛṛa.
43:56: Nerra ten d asmekti u d amedya, i ineggura.
43:57: Mi sen d iţţunefk mmi s n Meryem, d amedya, agdud ik iugwi t.
43:58: Qqaṛen: "ţţif iṛebbiten nneɣ, neɣ Neţţa"? Qqaṛen ak d akka, i nnmara. Ih, nitni d agdud iţmeṛẓan.
43:59: Neţţa d amdan kan. Nɣat it, Nerra t d amedya i At Isṛail.
43:60: Lemmer iɣ ɣ ihwi, a Nerr lmalayek di tmurt, deg umkan nnwen.
43:61: Neţţa, s tideţ, d ţţbut n yimir. Ur ţţilit di ccekk fellas. Ddut yidi; wagi d abrid uwqim.
43:62: Ur kwen issefraɣ Cciṭan! Ih, neţţa d acengu nnwen n ṣṣeḥ.
43:63: Mi n iusa Ɛisa s issekniyen, inna: "usiɣ d ɣuṛwen s ṣṣwab, ad awen beggneɣ kra, seg wayen iɣef temgarradem. Ihi, ḥezzbet i Ṛebbi, taɣem iyi awal.
43:64: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, d Mass iw u d Mass nnwen. Ihi, ɛabdet eṬ, d wagi ay d abrid uwqim".
43:65: Mgarraden ikabaren garasen. A tawaɣit n wid idensen, ilmend uɛaqeb n wass aqeṛḥan!
43:66: Day a ţṛaoun imir, ad asen d ias, deqzalla, nitni ur bnin?
43:67: Iḥbiben, assen, ad uɣalen wa d acengu n wa, kkes ed wid iţḥezziben.
43:68: A yimdanen iW, assa, ur telli tugdi fellawen, ur ɣwebblet!
43:69: - Wid iumnen s issekniyen nneɣ, u llan d imḍuɛen -
43:70: Kecmet Loennet, kunwi akked tlawin nnwen, a ţţezhum.
43:71: Ad asen ddewwiṛen, s sniwat n uwṛeɣ, akked ibuqalen; degsen ayen cihwant teṛwiḥin, ayen iqennɛen allen. Kunwi, din, ad twekkṛem.
43:72: D tagi ay d Loennet i tweṛtem, ilmend n wayen txeddmem.
43:73: Degs, i kunwi, aṭas n izwayen, segsen a ţţeččem.
43:74: Ibeɣwḍiyen, s tideţ, deg uɛaqeb n Loahennama, ad wekkṛen.
43:75: Ur iţfukku fellasen. Nitni, degs, ad kkufferen.
43:76: Ur ten Nednis, maca llan, nitni, d imednas.
43:77: Ad necden: "a Malik, xas ad aɣ Iqfeṛ Mass ik"! A d ini: "war ccekk, a ţwellfem"!
43:78: Niɣ Nusa n ɣuṛwen, s tideţ, maca tegwti, degwen, keṛhen tideţ.
43:79: Neɣ undin ticeṛkeţ. Ula d Nekwni Neţţandi.
43:80: Neɣ ɣilen ur Nsell ara i lesrar nnsen, akked tumlin nnsen. Ihi, imceggɛen nneɣ, ɣuṛsen, ţţarun.
43:81: Ini: "lemmer illi mmi s i Uḥnin, nek d aɛbad amenzu".
43:82: Gedha s Mass n tmurt akked igenwan, Mass n usgeld, mgal ayen ţxeṛṛiḍen!
43:83: Anef asen ad nexxṛen, ad uraren, alamma mmugren ass nnsen, i sen iţţuwaɛɛden.
43:84: D Neţţa ay d Ṛebbi deg igenni, d Ṛebbi di tmurt, u d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
43:85: Iṛqa Win Ilan tagelda n tmurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen. Iẓṛa melmi ay d imir. ɣuṛeS, ara tuɣalem.
43:86: Wid i la naɛṛen, war Neţţa, ur ɣuṛsen kra n ccafuɛa, kkes ed inagan n tideţ, u nitni ẓṛan.
43:87: Ma testeqṣaḍ ten anwa iten Ixelqen, a d inin, war ccekk, "d Ṛebbi". Ihi, acimi zzin akin?
43:88: Timenna s: "a Mass iw! Wigi, s tideţ, d agdud ur numin".
44:3: Nessader iţ id, ih, deg iḍ iṛqan. Ih, Nekwni, Nella d ineddaṛen!
44:5: Lameṛ sɣuṛneɣ. Ih, Nekwni Nella d wid Iţţaznen.
44:6: Aḥunu sɣuṛ Mass ik. Ih, Neţţa Isell, d Amusnaw.
44:7: Mass n tmurt, igenwan akked wayen illan garasen, ma teţţutebbtem.
44:8: Ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Issidir, Ineqq. D Mass nnwen, u Mass n lejdud nnwen, imezwura.
44:10: Qaṛaɛ ass, ideg ara d iawi igenni, abbu iţbegginen.
44:11: Ad iɣumm imdanen. Wagi d aɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
44:12: "A Mass nneɣ! Kkes aɣ aɛaqeb; nekwni d lmumnin"!
44:13: Amek ara sɛun asmekti, wanag iusa ten id Umazan iţbegginen?
44:14: Dɣa wexxṛen as, u nnan: "d aselmad aṛehbani".
44:15: Ma Nessenqes awen cwiṭ uɛaqeb, ihi, kunwi, a ţţuɣalem ar din.
44:16: Ass ideg ara Neẓdem fellasen, ẓẓedma tabarart, war ccekk, a d Nerr ţţaṛ.
44:17: Niɣ Njeṛṛeb, uqbel nnsen, agdud n Ferɛun. Iusa ten id umazan ukyis.
44:18: "Seddut yidi imdanen n Ṛebbi; nek, ɣuṛwen, d amazan muman.
44:19: Ur ssemɣwaṛet iman nnwen, zdat Ṛebbi. Nek, usiɣ d ɣuṛwen, s udabu n ṣṣeḥ.
44:20: Nek, ad iyi Isseṛ Mass iw u d Mass nnwen, ur iyi tṛeoomem.
44:21: Ma ur iyi tuminem ara, aɛzlet iyi".
44:22: Inuj ɣeṛ Mass is ar wigi d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen.
44:23: "Awi imdanen iW deg iḍ. War ccekk, a kwen in ḍefṛen.
44:24: Eoo ill ildi; nitni, ih, d lɛaskeṛ ara iɣemqen".
44:28: Akka ay ten Nefka d lweṛt i ugdud nniḍen.
44:29: Ur d run, fellasen, igenni akked tmurt. Ur ggunin.
44:30: Niɣ Nsellek At Isṛail, seg uɛaqeb isdullun,
44:31: si Ferɛun, i illan, s tideţ, d amnefxi ger imaɛfan.
44:32: S tmusni ay ten Nefren deg imaḍalen.
44:33: Nefka yasen seg issekniyen, wid ujeṛṛeb iţbegginen.
44:35: "Siwa tameţţant nneɣ tamezwarut, ur fellaɣ tanekra.
44:36: Awit ed imezwura nneɣ, ma tessawalem tideţ"!
44:37: Menyif nitni neɣ agdud n Tubbaɛ, akked wid i ten id izwaren? Nessenger iten. S tideţ, nitni llan d ibeɣwḍiyen.
44:38: Ur Nexliq ara tamurt, igenwan, akked wayen illan garasen, i wurar.
44:39: Nxelq iten kan s tideţ, maca, tegwti degsen, ur ssinen.
44:40: S tideţ, ass n ufraz, ad mlilen meṛṛa.
44:41: Ass ideg aḥbib ur iɣennu aḥbib, s wacemma; nitni ur ţwasellken.
44:42: Kkes ed wid iɣef Iḥun Ṛebbi. Neţţa, s tideţ, d Uzmir, Iţḥunu.
44:47: "Ddemt eţ, zuɣṛet eţ, ar ţnaṣfa ujajiḥ,
44:48: sinna, smiret sufella uqeṛṛu s, aɛaqeb iţţayzagen".
44:49: "Jeṛṛeb! Niɣ kečč d uzmir, d ukyis"!
44:50: Ih, wagi d ayen i la teţcukkum.
44:51: Wanag wid iḥezzben, deg umekkan n laman;
44:53: lebsa nnsen s leḥrir, leḥrir iḥewwcen. Mqabalen.
44:54: Akka, a ten Njewweo akked tḥuṛtin lɛin.
44:55: A d ssutren, dinna, yal izwayen, di laman.
44:56: Ur ţjeṛṛiben, dinna, tameţţant, siwa tameţţant tamezwarut. Isellek iten seg uɛaqeb ujajiḥ.
44:57: D lfeḍl n Mass ik, d wagi ay d rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan.
44:58: Nsehhel it kan, s tmeslayt ik, amendeṛ ma a d mmektin.
45:2: Tarusi n Tezmamt sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
45:3: Di tmurt akked igenwan, s tideţ, llan issekniyen i lmumnin.
45:4: Di lxelq nnwen, akked wayen id Issefṛuṛex n lewḥuc, d issekniyen i ugdud iţţutebbten.
45:5: Di lemgarda n yiḍ akked wass, akked wayen id Issrusu Ṛebbi n ṛṛeẓq, seg igenni - Issidir yis tamurt, deffir tmeţţant is -, deg udewwel n waḍu, issekniyen i ugdud iţmeyyizen.
45:6: D wigi ay d issekniyen n Ṛebbi; Nemmal ak ten, s tideţ. Anwa ameslay ara amnen, deffir Ṛebbi akked issekniyen iS?
45:8: Issemḥas i issekniyen n Ṛebbi, qqaṛen as ten, sinna, iggernen di temɣweṛ, amzun ur asen isli. Ihi, becceṛ it s uɛaqeb aqeṛḥan.
45:9: Ma illa wayen iwumi isla, seg issekniyen nneɣ, ad ittihi fellas. I widak, aɛaqeb isdullun.
45:10: Deffir sen Loahennama. Ur ten iɣennu s wacemma wayen kesben akked wayen rran d imawlan, war Ṛebbi. I nitni, aɛaqeb abarar.
45:11: Tagi d nnhaya. Wid iugin issekniyen n Mass nnsen, fellasen aɛaqeb n daɛwessu taqeṛḥant.
45:12: Ṛebbi i Inuben fellawen s yill; iţcali, fellas, lbabuṛ, s lameṛ iS; a ţnadim lɣit iS. Amar a ţţesnemrem!
45:13: Inub fellawen s wayen akw illan deg igenwan, akked wayen illan di tmurt. Akw sɣuṛeS. S tideţ, deg waya, d issekniyen i ugdud ismektayen.
45:14: Ini i wid iumnen ad semmḥen i wid ur negguni ara ussan n Ṛebbi, iwakken ad Ikafi agdud ɣef wayen keţţben.
45:15: Win ixedmen ayen ilhan, i iman is; win ifalṭan, mgal is. Sinna, ar Mass nnwen tuɣalin nnwen.
45:16: Niɣ Nefka, i At Isṛail, Tazmamt, ṣṣwab, lambiyya. Nṛeẓq iten s wayen ilhan. Nesmenyaf iten i imaḍalen.
45:17: Nefka yasen abeggen si Lameṛ. Ur mgarraden, armi i ten id tusa tmusni, wa iqheṛ wa. Ih, Mass ik ad Iḥudd garasen, ass n tnekra, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden.
45:18: Sinna, Nebbwi k deg ubrid n Lameṛ. Ddu degs, ur teddu akked chawi n wid ur nessin.
45:19: Ih, nitni ur ak d ţţawin acemma sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Imednas, ih, d imawlan wa n wa. Ṛebbi d Bab n wid iţḥezziben.
45:20: Ayagi d assekni i lɣaci, d nnhaya u d aḥunu i ugdud iţţutebbten.
45:21: Neɣ ɣilen wid imṛṛeṛen iman nnsen s tucmitin, a ten Neḥseb am wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d imuddiren neɣ d lmeggtin. Dir it uḥuddu nnsen.
45:22: Ṛebbi Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ, iwakken yal amdan ad iţţuqeṭṭi af wayen ikseb. Nitni ur ţwadensen.
45:23: Twalaḍ win irran lhawiyya s d ṛebbi is? Itelf it Ṛebbi, asali ɣuṛeS. Iskweṛ as ul, timejjin, Irra yas aɛbṛuq af allen is. Anwa ara t inhun, deffir Ṛebbi? Day u la tesmektayem ara?
45:24: Nnan: "i illan kan, d tudert nneɣ, di ddunit. A nemmet, a nidir. Ad aɣ inɣen kan d akud". ɣef ayagi, ur sɛin kra n tmusni. Nitni ɣilen kan.
45:25: Ma mlan asen issekniyen nneɣ iberrzen, anamer nnsen, siwa mara d inin: "erret ed imezwura nneɣ, ma tessawalem tideţ"!
45:26: Ini: "Ṛebbi Issidir ikwen, sinna, Ineqq ikwen. Sinna a kwen Issemlil ass n tnekra, ur illi degs ccekk". Maca, tegwti n yimdanen ur ssinen.
45:27: N Ṛebbi, tagelda n tmurt akked igenwan. Ass ideg ara d ias yimir, ass nni, ad xesṛen ucmiten.
45:28: A ţwaliḍ yal lois ɣef tgwecrar, yal lois iţwanced ar tezmamt is. Assa, a ţɣeltem ayen txeddmem.
45:29: Tagi d tazmamt nneɣ, tessawal tideţ fellawen. Nella Neţjerrid ayen akw txeddmem.
45:30: Ihi, wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Issekcem, Mass nnsen, s aḥunu S. Wagi d rrbeḥ n ṣṣeḥ.
45:31: Wanag wid ijehlen: "day ur awen ɣṛan ara issekniyen iW? Tesmeɣwṛem iman nnwen, tellam d agdud ibeɣwḍiyen".
45:32: Mi nnan: "ih, lemɛahda n Ṛebbi, d tideţ; imir, ur degs ccekk", tennam: "ur neẓṛi d acu ay d imir; ɣuṛneɣ d nnwaya kan, ur neţţutebbet".
45:33: Ad asen d ḍehṛent tucmitin xedmen, ad asen izzi wayen iɣef ttihin.
45:34: Ad asen Inin: "assa, a kwen Neţţu, akken teţţum timlilit n wass nnwen agi. Axxam nnwen d times, ur awen illi useṭṭaṛ.
45:35: Ayagi, acku kunwi la tettihim ɣef issekniyen n Ṛebbi. Tɣuṛṛ ikwen tudert n ddunit. Assa, ur d teffɣen segs". Ur istiɣfiṛ ḥedd fellasen.
45:36: I Ṛebbi annuz, Mass igenwan, Mass n tmurt, Mass imaḍalen.
45:37: I Neţţa akw ayen iufraren, di tmurt akked igenwan. Neţţa, d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
